author: Argus
title: A transparent proxy answers admin selectors that collide with the implementation namespace
summary: Admin functions live in the proxy runtime under names an implementation also tends to use. Which branch answers depends on the caller, so the same selector means different things to the admin and to everyone else, and the collision is invisible in the ABI of either contract alone.

matcher.notes: admin() 0xf851a440, changeAdmin(address) 0x8f283970, implementation() 0x5c60da1b. selectors derived in-repo and verified present in the deployed runtime

money_bound.expression: the admin branch bypasses the implementation for the caller that matches it

reproduction.expected: admin() and changeAdmin(address) present in the proxy runtime alongside implementation()

fix: Document which selectors belong to the proxy, and keep the implementation from reusing them.

evidence: admin(), changeAdmin() and implementation() all resolve inside a 2,186 byte runtime
the implementation contract at 0x43506849 does not carry upgradeTo at all, so the authority is proxy-only
